display_name: 原受损与四个恢复输出的五方互补性
description: 复用四个固定恢复输出及原始受损预测，计算五方正确性组合及不可部署的理论并集。
authorization: Existing user-authorized ground Main full predictions and truth-last same-row analysis; no target-driven training, model choice, thresholds or routing.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI NumPy, CPU2, CUDA empty, nice10; shared truth-side scoring lock.

data.representation: Existing fixed 168000 physical IDs × seven original Main views, raw/DURA and three candidate discrete predictions; no raw IQ.
data.physical_ids_ref: Original Main cross_rx and cross_both prediction IDs, required exactly equal across all three fixed candidates.
data.validation_ref: Original Main complete prediction and truth-last score artifacts, original source F0 identity; all candidates and both populations checked before truth.
data.support_query_ref: No targettraining/support/PCD/unknownrole. OriginalMain two populations168000,all7perrowfixedbefore independenttruth.
data.actual_training_labels: No training. Ground Main true TX used only for post-hoc descriptive scoring after all fixed prediction matrices are verified.
data.augmentation: No new augmentation, channel observations or model forwards.

permissions.query_use: Only previously fixed and scored original Main predictions and truth; no input IQ, neural inference, target fitting, threshold tuning, model selection or routing.
permissions.claim_scope: Post-hoc paired correctness analysis on previously exposed single-seed simulated ground benchmark; no theoretical limit or in-orbit claim.

checkpoint.initialization: No checkpoint or model loaded; use only original fixed prediction and completion artifacts.
sources: DURA_v1 and original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL baseline decisions reused and required identical across the three matrices.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: All matrices, physical IDs and F0 checked before truth; each raw/restorer pair marginal crosschecked against existing independent triple result.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No new trained state, neural forward, IQ reads or target fit; independent truth-side analysis after previously fixed predictions.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Three already reported candidate rows and fixed DURA are specified together; no test-driven reranking or per-TX routing.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; CUDA empty, two CPU threads, nice10. Wait for existing shared truth-side scorer lock before reading scored truth.
execution.stop_rule: Any prediction, F0, baseline ID, prior scorer, marginal or output collision mismatch: stop and preserve all artifacts.

metric_names: 32 joint correctness cells for raw received and four restored outputs; hypothetical fixed-output correctness union only.
Each raw/restorer pair marginal must match previous independent three-way aggregate.
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Three complete original 42-cell matrices, with identical raw and DURA baseline predictions.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: CPU-only fixed prediction analysis; shared score.lock, all matrices validated before truth; compare to original independent scores.

rows.purpose: Compute fixed-output complementarity upper bound, without training, choosing or deploying any selector.
rows.seed_notes: No new RNG. Original BF/F0 and original Main observations.
rows.scenario: Previously scored original Main clean plus six practical views
rows.budget_ref: No G/F inference or training. Truth-side correctness aggregation only after all 126 fixed prediction cells are verified.

notes: Post-hoc description of exposed single-seed Main; no target training, method selection, threshold or routing.
Five streams and output order fixed before reading truth; no new IQ or neural predictions.
Two synthetic and negative tests PASS; one independent P0/P1 review PASS.
Shared score.lock; original raw/restorer pair marginals must match previous independent scores.
